sql: select 'resting_orders_by_age' as k, case when now()-created_at > interval '24 hours' then '>24h' else '<24h' end as a, count(*)::text as b, sum(quantity)::text as c from live_orders where status in ('open','pending') group by 1,2 union all select 'live_orders_by_status', status, count(*)::text, max(created_at)::text from live_orders where created_at > now() - interval '48 hours' group by 1,2 union all select 'rejections_48h', coalesce(reject_reason,'(none)'), count(*)::text, '' from live_orders where status='rejected' and created_at > now() - interval '48 hours' group by 1,2 order by 1,2
